name: Alexandre de Gusmão
contribution: A Portuguese diplomat from Colonial Brazil.

checks.lead: Alexandre de Gusmão (17 July 1695 in Santos – 9 May 1753 in Lisbon) was a Portuguese diplomat from Colonial Brazil. He is regarded as one of the best diplomats of his time, chiefly for his role in negotiating the Treaty of Madrid in 1750 (revoked in 1761), when Portugal and Spain were attempting to delimit their territorial possessions in South America and Asia.
